sourceVerification.scopeNote: Preflight lists candidate changed/new files, not every unchanged tracked source. Unlisted files compare to the recorded HEAD with LF normalization, while exact working-byte capture hashes separately match current. Current drift is a later-source limitation, not a captured-frame inconsistency.

visualInspectionMethod: Actual original PNGs via view_image; all MP4 frames decoded and compared with original PNG sequence via SSIM. No claim of live realtime video playback or every frame visually reviewed.
